# Vegetation Recovery in a Trampled Dune System

::: {.cgm-page-lead}
Tracking coastal dune vegetation recovery following human trampling.
:::

[← All research](research.qmd)

::: {.cgm-page-body}

We investigate how coastal dune vegetation recovers from human trampling, with attention to recovery trajectories, species composition, and patterns of regrowth.
